description: Block dangerous shell commands (rm -rf /, sudo, chmod 777, dd, mkfs, fork bombs) before they hit Bash. Audit 2026-05-18 P0-3 — replaced broken `echo '$TOOL_INPUT'` pattern (single quotes prevent expansion; $TOOL_INPUT is not a shell env var — Claude Code passes hook input on stdin as JSON).

hooks.command: INPUT=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z_])rm[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*[rf][a-zA-Z]*[[:space:]]+)+/([[:space:]]|$)|^[[:space:]]*sudo[[:space:]]|chmod[[:space:]]+777|mkfs\.|dd[[:space:]]+if=|:\(\)\{[[:space:]]*:|fork[[:space:]]+bomb'; then printf 'BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected:\n%s\n' "$INPUT" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy the PreToolUse hook to .claude/settings.json. The command reads the tool input JSON from stdin (Claude Code passes hook payload there), extracts .tool_input.command via jq, then runs a deny-list regex. Exit code 2 prevents Bash invocation and the message on stderr is shown to Claude. Customize the regex to match your security policy — keep alternations anchored or you risk over-blocking (e.g. `farm` matches `arm`). Requires jq.
